remarks: Welcome to this expansive 1100sf 1-bedroom, 1-bathroom ranch-style unit nestled on the second floor, offering an abundance of space and comfort. This home features a generous living room, a full dining room, and a cozy galley kitchen, perfect for entertaining or enjoying quiet evenings at home.  In addition to the spacious interiors, this unit includes the convenience of a reserved parking space. The location is ideal for those who love the outdoors, as it's within walking distance to the beautiful Cummings Beach and Park. For commuters, the property provides easy access to the train station and I-95, making travel a breeze.  Please note that pets are not allowed, and excellent credit is a must for potential tenants. Don't miss the opportunity to make this wonderful space your new home!
